title: One forward row
statement: Let $I$ be an index type, let $f:\mathbb Z\to I\to\mathrm{OblPayload}$ be a payload family, and let $z\in\mathbb Z$. Applying the forward row transducer with left register $f(z-1)$ to the uncached row at $z$ gives register $f(z)$ and the cached row at $z$.
replaced:
For every payload family and every coordinate $z$, applying the forward transducer
with register the payloads at $z - 1$ to the uncached row at $z$ produces the payloads
at $z$ as the new register together with the cached row at $z$.
